resemblanceNotes: No documented pattern shares a keyword with this signal combination — zero votes, which is a gap in what the taxonomy's vocabulary covers, not a finding that the behaviour is new. Nothing here compares the case's signal types against the pattern's documented indicators. Resemblance is a keyword vote over the pattern's name, category and aliases, and a vote count cannot produce a difference. A section headed "What makes this different" listing resemblance sentences stated a comparison nobody made.

falsePositives.note: This case resembles no documented pattern, so no documented legitimate explanations are quoted here. That is an absence of a documented pattern, not a finding that there is no innocent explanation — a case nothing in the taxonomy matches is the one an innocent explanation is hardest to look up.
